🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF, with mixed breadth: Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmation comes from rising fear, with VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +27.51% | 1M: +31.36%), and falling stocks versus bonds, with SPY/TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.11% | 1M: -9.98%).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear is rising: VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +27.51% | 1M: +31.36%). Credit stress is rising as HYG/LQD falls (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -1.91%), BELOW TREND; bonds are also outperforming stocks, with SPY/TLT falling (1W: -3.11% | 1M: -9.98%), BELOW TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Dollar strength is flat and BELOW TREND (1W: -0.28% | 1M: -0.21%); the yield-curve signal is rising and ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.15% | 1M: +4.61%). Duration is supported: TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.20%).

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Defensive and select sectors are holding up: XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.48% | 1M: +11.69%) and XLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +9.54%); XLF is also ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +6.98%). Tech is sharply weaker: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -13.97% | 1M: -19.37%); Style: Value over Growth, supported by sector breadth, with Technology breadth notably weaker than Financials.

5. US vs Global?
US equities are BELOW TREND: SPY (1W: -4.73% | 1M: -5.69%). China is showing relative strength, with FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +4.55%), while broader emerging markets remain weak: EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -7.45% | 1M: -13.83%).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative appetite is weakening: ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -14.91% | 1M: -17.16%) and IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -8.85%). Small caps are also BELOW TREND: IWM (1W: -4.59% | 1M: -2.42%).

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Gold is in RECOVERY: GLD (1W: +1.88% | 1M: -0.10%); copper remains BELOW TREND: CPER (1W: -5.97% | 1M: -6.15%). Relative copper weakness versus gold is confirmed by CPER/GLD falling, BELOW TREND (1W: -9.21% | 1M: -4.53%).

8. Energy Trend?
Energy is weak: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -10.30% | 1M: -2.73%), while Brent is in CORRECTION: BNO (1W: -11.63% | 1M: +1.02%). Natural gas is in RECOVERY: UNG (1W: +0.98% | 1M: -15.96%).

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Equity weakness in SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -4.73% | 1M: -5.69%) and XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -13.97% | 1M: -19.37%); duration strength persists in TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.20%). Cross-asset signals reinforce RISK-OFF, while the 6/11 breadth reading remains mixed rather than uniformly weak.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor relative resilience in XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.48% | 1M: +11.69%) and XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +6.98%); reduce exposure to technology weakness in XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -13.97% | 1M: -19.37%). Bonds remain supported in TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.20%).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If relative resilience persists, favor XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.48% | 1M: +11.69%) and XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +6.98%).
BEARISH: If technology weakness extends, watch XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -13.97% | 1M: -19.37%) for further downside confirmation.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If haven demand holds, monitor GLD in RECOVERY (1W: +1.88% | 1M: -0.10%).
BEARISH: If industrial-cycle weakness persists, watch CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -5.97% | 1M: -6.15%).

13. Key Levels?
Monitor HYG/LQD at 0.7384 (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -1.91%), falling and BELOW TREND; SPY/TLT at 8.9467 (1W: -3.11% | 1M: -9.98%), falling and BELOW TREND. The XLK/XLF ratio is 2.8240 (1W: -11.10% | 1M: -22.57%), falling and BELOW TREND; CPER/GLD is 0.0995 (1W: -9.21% | 1M: -4.53%), falling and BELOW TREND.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, with Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; rising VXX and falling SPY/TLT confirm defensive pressure. Defensive-sector resilience and Value over Growth are evident in XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.48% | 1M: +11.69%) versus XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -13.97% | 1M: -19.37%). Monitor rising fear and credit stress, with HYG/LQD falling (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -1.91%).
